payload.content: The mandate cannot be completed from this record. I have a fictional three-year horizon, but no executable price, yield, secondary-market liquidity,
or series-level payment evidence. The coupon is not a yield. The scheduled maturity is not proof of payment. I can only recommend a research
checklist: confirm the series terms and security, obtain a current price/yield and liquidity assessment, and verify the payment outcome when it
occurs. I cannot size a position or recommend a purchase.
